abort.already_configured: HA Desktop Widget is already configured.

user.description: Set up the Home Assistant Companion integration for HA Desktop Widget. This does not install the desktop app. On each computer, download and install HA Desktop Widget from {releases_url}, then open the app and choose Connect with Home Assistant.
user.title: Set up HA Desktop Widget

apply_profile.name: Apply profile
apply_profile.description: Assign a profile to one or more desktops and apply it now to those that are online. Offline desktops receive it when they next connect, and later revisions of the profile follow automatically.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Name or ID of the profile to apply.

capture_profile.name: Capture profile
capture_profile.description: Save a desktop's current layout as a profile. A profile with the same name gets a new revision, which desktops assigned to it then apply.

device_id.name: Desktop
device_id.description: Registered desktop whose layout to capture.

name.name: Profile name
name.description: Name of the profile to create or update.

delete_profile.name: Delete profile
delete_profile.description: Delete a profile and clear it from any desktops it is assigned to. Their current layout is left unchanged.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Name or ID of the profile to delete.

hide.description: Hide the widget on one or more connected desktops.
hide.name: Hide widget

save_profile.name: Save profile
save_profile.description: Create or update a profile from a layout document. A changed document gets a new revision, which desktops assigned to the profile then apply.

name.name: Profile name
name.description: Name of the profile to create or update.

document.name: Document
document.description: Profile layout sections, as produced by Capture profile or the desktop app.

show.description: Show the widget on one or more connected desktops.
show.name: Show widget

switch_page.description: Switch one or more connected desktops to a named page.

page_id.description: Stable page or tab identifier understood by the desktop.
page_id.name: Page ID

switch_page.name: Switch page

toggle.description: Toggle widget visibility on one or more connected desktops.
toggle.name: Toggle widget

unassign_profile.name: Unassign profile
unassign_profile.description: Stop keeping one or more desktops in sync with a profile. Their current layout is left unchanged.
